name: 993 seat rail trim cover, outer side (PicoGK)
material_candidate: polymer, grade to be determined after fit test (FFF / SLS / MJF candidates; PA12 density used for the mass estimate)
picogk_enhancement: The F0 U-channel block becomes a moulded-looking trim cover: crowned top, drafted walls, rounded edges, end caps ramping down to a low nose, transverse ribs under the crown, countersunk screw bosses in the end ramps and slotted snap tongues with lead-in hook lips - one open-bottom shell, no trapped volume.

length_mm.note: F0 hypothesis: assumed rail length (longueur de glissiere supposee)

width_mm.note: F0 hypothesis, width at the open face

height_mm.note: F0 hypothesis, height at the crown

side_draft_mm.note: side wall inward draft over the height

end_ramp_length_mm.note: length over which each end cap ramps down

plan_corner_radius_mm.note: plan radius of the end caps

rib_count.note: transverse stiffening ribs under the crown

rib_depth_mm.note: ribs end 20 mm above the open face to clear the rail

clips_per_side.note: snap tongues per side wall; real fixing unknown

clip_slot_height_mm.note: free tongue height from the open edge

clip_slot_mm.note: slot width either side of a tongue

screw_boss_diameter_mm.note: screw boss in each end ramp

screw_hole_diameter_mm.note: through hole for an assumed 4 mm trim screw

countersink_diameter_mm.note: 90 deg countersink at the top surface

open_interfaces: seat and rail variant (differs by equipment)
real fixing method (clips, screws or both) and positions
left/right symmetry to be verified before mirroring
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
